issues.title: [B01] Validate organism selections against a cached catalog
issues.body:
<!-- phytominer-backlog:B01 -->

Priority: **P1**

### Problem

Unknown target names currently look like valid selections with no matches.

### Scope

Resolve supported organism IDs and exact names using cached service metadata; distinguish invalid selection from no homologs.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unknown and ambiguous selections raise actionable errors.
- [ ] Valid organisms with no reported matches return a valid empty result.
- [ ] Catalog reuse avoids whole-genome enumeration.

### Dependencies

None required.

### Implementation context

Open follow-up; not implemented by the three correctness fixes.

Code: [repository source](https://github.com/karikris/PhytoMiner/blob/{{release_sha}}/phytominer/workflows.py)

Verified release CI: {{ci_url}}
acceptance: Unknown and ambiguous selections raise actionable errors.
Valid organisms with no reported matches return a valid empty result.
Catalog reuse avoids whole-genome enumeration.
